evals.prompt: fixtures/public/sample.dsd 내용을 읽기 좋은 마크다운으로 만들어 줘.
evals.hard_because: Generic unzip shows mojibake image names and raw XML; &cr; tokens, editor comments, and span tables need DSD-specific handling, and the CLI deliberately emits no Markdown.
evals.expected_output: Runs inspect/outline, then read and table for each T#, and writes sample.md beside the source itself. Headings follow SECTION-n levels, the rowspan/colspan shareholder table keeps its spans (for example as HTML), &cr; becomes a line break, figures and spacing are copied from read/table output, ◆click◆ scaffolding is omitted, and the image is written out from extract if it is linked. Does not upload or paste the full document elsewhere.

evals.prompt: sample.dsd 재무상태표에서 당기 현금및현금성자산을 1,100,000으로 바꿔줘. 원본은 그대로 두고.
evals.hard_because: The figure must be located by table/row/column; totals depend on it, and a regenerated XML or re-zip would corrupt CP949 image names.
evals.expected_output: Locates T3R4C2 with find/table, writes a new file with set-cell, leaves the original untouched, runs check --against and diff showing exactly one changed cell, and reports that 유동자산 (T3R3C2) and 자산총계 (T3R6C2) now disagree with the new figure unless the user asked to update them.

evals.prompt: Change the reporting period end in sample.dsd to 2026-12-31.
evals.hard_because: The cover date is a TU cell whose AUNITVALUE must change with the display text.
evals.expected_output: Uses set-cell on T1R2C1 with --text '2026년 12월 31일' and --unit-value 20261231, considers the period-start cell and other period references, and verifies with check (no unit-value warning) and diff.

evals.prompt: sample.dsd 주주 현황 표에 '김철수 / 0 / 0.00%' 행을 추가해 줘.
evals.hard_because: Row copying must respect ROWSPAN headers and keep TE ACODE attributes.
evals.expected_output: Copies a body row of T4 (not a header row inside the ROWSPAN) with copy-row --clear or an apply batch, fills the three cells with set-cell, writes a new file, and verifies check/diff. Does not hand-build the row with an XML library.

evals.hard_because: Bulk replacement can hit TU cells whose AUNITVALUE also needs changing, and overwriting the source needs explicit authority, which this request gives.
evals.expected_output: Runs replace --dry-run to see every occurrence (including the two TU cover dates, flagged as keeping their AUNITVALUE), replaces with the verified --expect count or uses set-cell --unit-value for the TU cells so machine values follow, writes with --force to the source only because the user asked to overwrite, and reports TU machine values and other period dependents.

evals.prompt: 이 DSD 파일 구조만 알려줘. 내용은 보여주지 마.
evals.hard_because: Confidential content must not be echoed.
evals.expected_output: Uses inspect (and outline only if headings are acceptable), reporting versions, member list, counts, and issues without quoting document text.

evals.prompt: T5 3행 금액을 2,500,000으로 바꾼 사본 만들어 줘. (dsd set-cell crashes on this file.)
evals.hard_because: The CLI defect must be worked around without abandoning the edit, and the public issue must not leak the confidential document.
evals.expected_output: Completes the edit by the extract/pack route and verifies it with check and diff, then in the report offers a GitHub issue for cpaikr/dsdai: searches existing issues, drafts a title and body with placeholder paths, the error code and message minus document text, versions from inspect and dsd --version, and an invented reproduction fragment, and files it with gh only after the user approves.

evals.hard_because: The executable is missing; installation must follow the published guide without inventing commands, then the original task must resume.
evals.expected_output: Reads references/installation.md, installs dsd from the public GitHub Release with the guide's verified installer (or asks for release files when offline), verifies dsd --version by full path and by name, then completes the reading task. Does not treat later update advisories as an upgrade request.

evals.prompt: fixtures/public/sample.dsd와 동료가 고친 sample_v2.dsd를 비교해서 차이를 보기 쉽게 정리해줘.
evals.hard_because: A positional diff misaligns once tables are inserted or reordered; figures must be compared as numbers and the report must stay local.
evals.expected_output: Runs dsd compare BASE OTHER (JSON or --format text) to read the differences and writes the side-by-side report with --format html -o beside the sources. Summarizes changed values with their deltas, rows and columns only on one side, moved rows, and reworded paragraphs by section, names sample.dsd as the base, and does not upload either file or the report.

evals.prompt: sample.dsd 재무상태표에 제 3 기 비교 열을 하나 더 추가하고, 주주 표에 주주 한 명을 추가해줘.
evals.hard_because: Adding a column changes COL widths, the table WIDTH, and every row; the shareholder table has a header ROWSPAN/COLSPAN that must stay consistent.
evals.expected_output: Uses copy-col --clear on T3 and copy-row --clear on a T4 body row (or apply), then sets the new header and cells with set-cell; leaves the original untouched; runs check --against with no new cell-width or cell-height warnings and diff or compare showing exactly the added column and row; reports the empty figures for the user to fill.
